items.title: OpenSearch Query, Search & Aggregation Guideline: How to Query Properly & Effectively
items.description: Principal engineering guideline on writing fast, memory-safe OpenSearch queries: Query vs Filter Context (Roaring Bitmap caches), Point-in-Time (PIT) + search_after deep pagination, high-cardinality aggregations, and Hybrid BM25 + k-NN Vector Search.

items.title: Search Systems
items.description: Design patterns for full-text search, autocomplete, faceted search, and search-as-you-type using Elasticsearch, inverted indexes, and Spring Data Elasticsearch.
